qaHistory.question: Compare useMemo, useCallback, and React.memo. In what scenarios can unnecessary memoization degrade performance?
qaHistory.idealAnswer: useMemo caches the calculated result of a heavy computational function, useCallback caches function instance references between renders, and React.memo prevents component re-renders if props have not changed. Overusing memoization adds memory overhead and comparison cost for simple calculations where re-creating functions is cheaper than storing cache references.
